name: ci_cd_no_color
title: CLI tools in CI must use --no-color to avoid ANSI corruption
symptom: CI logs and PR comments contain raw ANSI escape codes that corrupt output and break parsing
cause: CLI tools emit ANSI color codes when not a TTY; CI captures raw stdout
fix: Use --no-color / NO_COLOR env var / -color=false for all CLI tools in CI steps and scripts
mal_code: terraform plan -detailed-exitcode  # emits ANSI in CI
